notes: Corrected: the single written 'the' of 'the evil arrows of famine' moves from the attributive's article (s008) to the chain's own article on הָרָעָב (s006). Rule 29 gives the fronted 'the' to a rectum's article where the rectum is rendered anarthrously ('of famine'), and rule 47's first-article rule points the same way; rule 47's own 'the great city' case shows that standing before 'evil' in English does not settle it. The competing reading is named in that unit's note.
אוֹתָם in the relative clause is left wholly unrendered, so both marker and suffix are unrepresented (rules 16, 22).
'the famine' in the second half takes a supplied determiner: no article morpheme stands on רָעָב there.
